description.value: The "CH ELM Results Gene Cpe" group provides a curated set of codes representing specific genotypes. Each code within this group is selected to ensure consistency and accuracy for medical coding related to the primary LOINC codes. Clients using the "CH ELM Results Gene Cpe" group should refer to the provided codes to ensure they capture and report antibiotic information correctly and consistently
